title: VESTA
description: Website for a company providing independent valuation and expert assessment services.
infotext: Designed in Figma, built on Next.js, content managed in Directus.
company: Since 2014, VESTA has been carrying out independent expert assessments and valuations. Working across many industries, it helps businesses and private clients get objective, well-founded conclusions. Professional experience and strict adherence to regulatory standards let VESTA deliver accurate assessments and full transparency at every stage, making it a reliable partner in valuation and expertise.
problem: The company's old website no longer met modern requirements and didn't reflect its current services or brand values. The task was to create a new website with a distinctive design, easy navigation and correct display on every device, along with a modern logo and a refreshed brand identity.
mockups_description: I analysed the user experience and the competitive landscape and proposed improvements based on the findings. I then designed a new logo and brand identity, created and approved a modern website, filled it with content, and tested and optimised it.
result: The project has a modern style that underlines the character of the brand. It is an effective tool for attracting clients, meets current requirements, improves how the company is perceived and is easy to use.
meta_title: Case study: website and brand identity for VESTA
meta_description: Website for VESTA, a company providing independent valuation and expert assessment services.
